candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (fast, ~1ms), causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Payment logs show repeated 503s including on /readyz, indicating payment is unavailable/unhealthy rather than slow.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within payment (config, dependency, or crash) not established; payment metrics excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces show gateway checkout 502s originating from order, which fails because payment returns 503 on /v1/authorizations; inventory/reservations succeed. Payment logs confirm sustained 503s. Bounded to payment unavailability causing upstream 502s; specific payment-internal fault not yet established.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics showing why /v1/authorizations and /readyz return 503 (dependency failure, config, or crash)
Payment dependency topology and downstream health to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or bad-configuration
